rule: Treat every substantive prior proposal as applied, including optional/design-only/rejected-for-cost proposals. Alternative implementations overlap and counts are not independent ideas.
scope: 23 placed packets a-w; all five ZIPs currently in docs/incoming at closing refresh (28 packets total); full incoming index searched without recursively claiming review of every unrelated historically linked manuscript.
method: Primary-report section census; mechanism reading of reports and cumulative ledgers; substantive notes and prototypes inspected for candidate-specific distinctions. A text hit is not itself a substantive proposal and lack of a hit is not proof of global originality.
